_doc: Dispatch 5.17: tightened rect coordinates to mockup baseline pixel-precise bounds (Eser dispatch 5.9 mockup-anchored canonical mandate preserved; NOT engine-anchored). Dispatch 5.16 visual mockup match achieved → tighter rects now contain content without slack. Per-region rationale documents extraction source + dispatch 5.17 tighten note. Thresholds calibrated separately in S3 (W-17 threshold-up guard preserved).
